title: Myotonic Dystrophy Family Registry
summary: The Myotonic Dystrophy Family Registry (MDFR) is an online, patient-entered database that collects information on myotonic dystrophy (DM) to aid researchers in developing new, effective treatments and help identify participants for research studies and clinical trials.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with congenital, juvenile-onset or adult onset DM1 or DM2 (confirmed by clinical exam or genetic test)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not diagnosed with DM, unaffected family members
